name: input-group
title: InputGroup
description: A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

manifest.name: input-group
manifest.title: InputGroup
manifest.description: A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.
manifest.usage: Use InputGroup when something belongs to the input: a search icon, a fixed prefix (postgres://), a unit (ms), or an action on the value (Copy, Test, Show). Put InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton before or after InputGroupInput in the order they should appear, and wrap the group in a Field for its label and error. For an unrelated action next to an input, use a plain Input and a Button side by side. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fluent's field appearance: outline (a light fill, a hairline and the darker bottom edge), underline (the bottom edge only), filled-darker (color.bg.inset) or filled-lighter (color.bg.surface).

props.name: size
props.description: Fluent's field sizes: 24, 32 and 40 px when comfortable (caption-1, body-1, body-2), 22, 28 and 34 px when compact (size.control.sm, md, lg).

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element as the frame.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: input
slots.description: InputGroupInput, Base UI's Input without its own frame; data-slot="input-group-input".

slots.name: addon
slots.description: InputGroupAddon, an icon or text; data-slot="input-group-addon".

parts.name: InputGroupInput
parts.description: The text control (Base UI's Input): takes a Field's label and validity; its value, onValueChange and onBlur as Input's.

parts.name: InputGroupAddon
parts.description: An icon or text in color.fg.muted; clicking it focuses the control.

parts.name: InputGroupButton
parts.description: A Button (ghost by default) one size smaller than the group, inset from the frame; Button's props.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: The control has focus: the frame shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline). The button shows its own double ring instead.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The control is invalid (aria-invalid): the frame takes the danger hairline and bottom edge.

states.name: invalid-in-field
states.description: Invalid inside a Field (data-invalid on the control): the danger hairline and bottom edge.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The control is disabled: the frame drops its fill and takes Fluent's disabled stroke and text.

accessibility: The control is a native <input>; give it a FieldLabel through a Field, or aria-label. Addon text is not part of its name: say in the label or description what a prefix means.
Icon is aria-hidden in an addon unless it has a label; an icon-only InputGroupButton needs aria-label.
Tab moves from the control to the button; the frame's focus underline follows the control, the button has its own double focus ring.
Clicking an addon focuses the control, so the whole frame is a click target.

The frame's bottom edge (color.border.control-bottom) meets 3:1 on every fill and surface; invalid turns the hairline color.status.danger.border and the bottom edge color.status.danger.solid (3:1), with FieldError's message, not colour alone.
